biggest_catch: Restricted field of membership: the credit union serves firefighters, their immediate families, fire-department employees, and firefighter association members nationwide - this offer is not available to the general public. The $250 requires two consecutive months of $1,000+/month direct deposits and pays within 90 days after that.
catches: Be eligible for membership: active or retired firefighters, immediate family members, fire-department employees, or firefighter association members (nationwide service; branches in AZ, CA, FL, TN, TX, WA).
Open a new checking account as a new Firefighters First Credit Union member; offer valid for 12 months from the opening date of membership.
Set up and receive direct deposits of at least $1,000 per month for two consecutive months.
Bonus paid within 90 days following the second consecutive month of $1,000+ direct deposits.
Incentives are taxable income and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Fees may reduce earnings; no minimum balance required to open.

when_cash_arrives: Bonus $250. Per official terms: Bonus paid within 90 days following the second consecutive month of $1,000+ direct deposits; offer valid for 12 months from membership open date. Earliest realistic: ~5.0 months (2 monthly DD cycles + up to 3 months).
maximize: Fastest honest path. The offer requires consecutive months of direct deposits — payroll cycles are the hard floor and cannot be compressed. Fastest honest path: set up a real payroll direct deposit immediately (Zelle/bank transfers typically don't count) and keep it running uninterrupted; a missed month restarts the clock.
